name: PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk
summary: PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages toll roads in Indonesia. It operates through four segments: Toll Road, Water Supply, Energy, and Port. The company also provides trade and construction, port management, clean water supply and waste management, and telecommunication services. In addition, it engages in the renewable energy business. The company was formerly known as PT Metamedia Technologies Tbk and changed its name to PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk in June 2006. PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Nusantara Infrastructure Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Metro Pacific Tollways Indonesia.
